term: shared-timeline presence scopes and within-world propagation
definition: For History W B T and bearer x, Worldwise means ∀w ∃t IsAt w x t; Common means ∃t ∀w IsAt w x t; AllTime means ∀w ∀t IsAt w x t. Uniform means ∀w s t, IsAt w x s → IsAt w x t. W, B and T are separate types and T is shared by all worlds. History.now provides a time even with no world or bearer inhabitants. No order or accessibility restriction is used.
note: Analyst controls for #469. The finite interpretations use Bool/Unit/Bool. Uniform is an explicit temporal restriction, not a source claim or conservation axiom; no CoherentAtNow is assumed. A source-derived eternity bridge would require its own witness and faithful meaning.
